The load: 652 gestures of the 718 expected, in 144 s; reads_refused 0, writes_refused 0, unauthorised 0, conditions.load.refusals empty (a lone refusal, max(floor(1 % of n), 1), would be tolerated and named there); 7 reads and 7 writes refused by the marking (409 STATE_FORBIDS_OPERATION), counted apart as reads_frozen and writes_frozen. Gaps already decided, outside the table: createRevision on PRJ-001 is 2.35 s for the 2 s asked (decision of 2026-11-15, #3314 option B, US-2240), not an operation of table 15; the duration that redates 957 tasks, about 0.8 s, gain under the dispersion (decisions of 2026-11-16, US-2250), is read in recompute-after-entry. Not served, with their epic: the indicators and the projection of expenses (EP-10), the portfolio (EP-11), the compared grid and the entry in a compared grid (EP-27). The three hundred projects and fifteen years of revisions of the reference set (WF-QUA-0040) are for EP-13, which replays this measure on it. The volume of the guarded reads (US-2270) is NOT measured by this report: it is a calculation validated by the author, not a measure. 76 bytes per node x 5994 nodes (PRJ-001) x 600 projects x 180 revisions = about 49 GB, that is 25 to 33 % of the 150 to 200 GB of 4.6.2 (the 82 GB put forward earlier is not retained). Hypotheses: 5994 nodes per revision, that of PRJ-001, for every project; 180 revisions guarded per project, every marked revision read at least once (a revision never read is not guarded); 76 bytes per node as stored, without the compression of PostgreSQL, which would lower it.
